Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Jasmeet Singh
ORDER % 20.03.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 662/2016 dated 14.08.2016 u/s 498A/354/406/34 IPC registered at PS Neb Sarai, District South Delhi.
The parties have arrived at a settlement, as per which a sum of Rs. 3.25 lakhs was to be paid.
A sum of Rs. 2 lakhs has already been paid and the petitioner has also tendered a draft of Rs. 1.25 lakhs in Court today.
However, respondent No. 2 who is the mother states that there is a 13 years old child and she is finding it increasingly difficult to cater to his educational needs.
Respondent No. 2 states that in addition to Rs. 3.25 lakhs, the petitioner should contribute some amount directly towards payment of his school fee.
The said proposal is not acceptable to the petitioner who is present in Court and states that he will not pay anything more than the agreed amount.
Even though settlement has been arrived at, the rights of the child cannot be settled between the parties in view of the dicta of 'Ganesh vs. Sudhir Kumar Srivastava' [(2020) 20 SCC 787].

entities.text: Ganesh vs. Sudhir Kumar Srivastava' [(2020) 20 SCC 787]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For the said reasons, issue notice.
Mr. Mahant Choubey, learned counsel appears and accepts notice for respondent No. 2, seeks and is granted 4 weeks to file a reply.

Mr. Utkarsh, learned APP accepts for the State and submits that he shall address legal arguments and he does not wish to file a response.
